nodes.description: BotProtected.owner internal address: privileged owner, assigned tx.origin in WrappedSienna constructor, gates delegate() and list().
BotProtected.protectionFromBots: address of the external Ferrum bot-protection contract invoked through low-level calls.
BotProtected.uniPair public address: Uniswap pair computed in the constructor and forwarded to the bot-protection call.
BotProtected.checkBots modifier: performs a raw call to protectionFromBots with selector 0x15274141 and requires the returned flag, on every transferFrom.
BotProtected constructor: stores the bot protection contract address. Note: owner is never initialized here.
msg.sender: caller of transfer/transferFrom/approve and the value compared against owner in delegate()/list().
block.timestamp: miner-controllable deadline passed to the Uniswap router in list().
tx.origin: used as owner and granted unlimited allowance over uniPair, enabling phishing-based privilege takeover.
Low-level call protectionFromBots.call(...) inside checkBots: external arbitrary code execution on every transfer, return data length not validated.
a.delegatecall(b) in delegate(): arbitrary delegatecall preserving storage context, guarded only by the tx.origin-derived owner check.
External call to routerForUniswap.addLiquidityETH forwarding msg.value with a timestamp-based deadline.
WrappedSienna constructor: sets owner = tx.origin, computes uniPair, grants unlimited allowances to the router and to tx.origin.
transfer(_to,_value) public payable: forwards to transferFrom(msg.sender,_to,_value).
transferFrom(_from,_to,_value) public payable with checkBots: unchecked allowance/balance bookkeeping without SafeMath.
approve(_spender,_value) public payable: sets allowance[msg.sender][_spender].
delegate(address a, bytes b) public payable: owner-gated arbitrary delegatecall.
pairFor(tokenA,tokenB) internal pure: deterministic UniswapV2 pair address derivation.
list(_numList,_reallyGoHere,_amounts) public payable: owner-gated liquidity provisioning plus external bot-protection call and unchecked balance overwrites.
mapping(address=>uint) balanceOf: token balances mutated without overflow checks.
mapping(address=>mapping(address=>uint)) allowance: approval state including the unlimited router and tx.origin allowances.
totalSupply initialized to 66666000000000000000000 and used in unchecked arithmetic in list().
decimals constant = 18.
name = "SiennaVEST".
symbol = "vestSIENNA".
routerForUniswap: UniswapV2 router instance at 0x7a250d5630B4cF539739dF2C5dAcb4c659F2488D.
wETH address constant used for the liquidity pair derivation.
Unchecked arithmetic in transferFrom: allowance[_from][msg.sender] -= _value, balanceOf[_from] -= _value, balanceOf[_to] += _value with no SafeMath on Solidity 0.7.
Unchecked low-level call protectionFromBots.call(0xd5eaf4c3, _reallyGoHere) inside list(); return value ignored.
Unchecked arithmetic in list(): totalSupply * 6 / 100 and direct balanceOf overwrites with unvalidated values.
